subject: Security gate roadmap & DPA clarifications — MAP draft
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emma Singh <emma.singh@bluecrestbank.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security gate roadmap & DPA clarifications — MAP draft

Emma — thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our discussion, I attached a draft mutual action plan focused on the compliance gates we heard were most important to BlueCrest (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA & data retention). Please consider this a proposed sequencing and responsibility matrix — we want minimal friction for your internal reviewers.

Key asks from our side: 
- Can you confirm the legal owner for DPA redlines (name + email)?
- Which team will own SIG spreadsheet intake (security or procurement)?
- Any hard constraints on retention windows (e.g., 7y/3y/90d) beyond your standard bank policy?

What I attached: MAP-security-checklist-v2.xlsx (MAP + milestones), plus a link to our SOC 2 snapshot. Lauren is looped on legal/DPA items.

Proposed near-term timeline (high level):
- Week 1: SIG intake + DPA redline receipt
- Week 2: SOC 2 evidence packet & vendor questionnaire review
- Week 3: Finalize DPA + sign DocuSign; operational onboarding begins

If that sequencing looks off, tell us where to compress. We can make the SIG intake parallel with DPA review if your security team has capacity.

Thanks — I’ll follow up in 48 hours if I haven’t heard back.

— Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP-security-checklist-v2.xlsx]
[Attachment: Redwood-SOC2-report-Q4-2026.pdf]

From: Emma Singh <emma.singh@bluecrestbank.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Rohit Patel <rohit.patel@bluecrestbank.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Security gate roadmap & DPA clarifications — MAP draft

Vivek — thanks for the summary and the MAP. Helpful. A few quick notes from our side: 

1) DPA redline owner: Legal & Privacy are the same owner for this work — Rohit Patel (cc’d). He’ll be the primary reviewer; procurement will help coordinate signature.
2) SIG intake: please send the spreadsheet directly to security@bluecrestbank.com and cc Rohit. They prefer we supply pre-filled answers where possible.
3) Retention: our baseline for vendor data is 7 years for transaction metadata, 3 years for derived analytics, and 90 days for transient request logs. We can discuss carveouts but that’s the starting point.

Two asks for you: can you attach your latest SIG-friendly export (or tell me what tabs we should expect), and we’ll share our DPA template by COB tomorrow.

— Emma
Director, Vendor Risk | BlueCrest Bank
[Attachment: BlueCrest-SIG-fill.xlsx]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rohit Patel <rohit.patel@bluecrestbank.com>; Emma Singh <emma.singh@bluecrestbank.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security gate roadmap & DPA clarifications — MAP draft

Rohit / Emma — looping Legal in for the DPA redline. A few notes ahead of your template: 

- We prefer to keep substitution for data transfer and residency aligned with Section 7 of our standard DPA (I’ll attach a redline). If BlueCrest requires EU residency-only, that is doable but will affect timelines/pricing.
- Retention windows: Redwood’s typical defaults are configurable by account; we can match the 7y/3y/90d windows you listed but need to confirm the scope (production data vs. analytics-only).
- SOC 2: the attached Q4 2026 snapshot covers our control environment; SOC 2 plus control evidence can be provided under an NDA if you need raw artifacts.

I’ve attached a DPA-redline-v20270302.docx (tracks our suggested language) and flagged the few clauses where legal sign-off is typically iterative. Markus is copied for security/ops calendaring.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: DPA-redline-v20270302.docx]
[Attachment: Redwood-SOC2-report-Q4-2026.pdf]

From: Rohit Patel <rohit.patel@bluecrestbank.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Singh <emma.singh@bluecrestbank.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 10:20:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Security gate roadmap & DPA clarifications — MAP draft

Thanks Lauren — quick follow-ups from legal: 
- We’ll review the redline and aim to return comments by Fri COB (5 Mar). If your clause on "data subject export" is firm, flag it now — we’ll need product confirmation if we request alternate wording.
- SOC 2 evidence: can you confirm whether the SOC 2 packet includes control-owner contact info and the last penetration test summary? If not in the snapshot, we’ll request a short addendum.

Operationally — can Markus share an estimated window for SOC evidence review (how many business days once we hand SIG + list of requested artifacts)? Storing the timeline in the MAP will help procurement commit to a close date.

— Rohit
Legal & Privacy | BlueCrest Bank

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emma Singh <emma.singh@bluecrestbank.com>, Rohit Patel <rohit.patel@bluecrestbank.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security gate roadmap & DPA clarifications — MAP draft

All — appreciate the quick turn. Update and next steps below.

1) Attachments & SIG intake: we prepared a SIG-friendly export and prefilled the BlueCrest sheet based on our conversation. See "BlueCrest-SIG-fill.xlsx" attached and we uploaded the same to the HubSpot company record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765 (access: security@bluecrestbank.com).

2) SOC 2 packet scope: the snapshot includes control descriptions and our auditor statement. Per Rohit’s ask: we can provide a short penetration test summary and control-owner names under an NDA. If you need the raw evidence bundle, we’ll treat that as a gated deliverable (delivery estimate: 5 business days after SIG + artifact list).

3) DPA redline: Lauren has attached our suggested edits. Rohit — expect our comments back by Fri COB; if there are major redline changes that require product input (exports/residency), please flag them in one email and copy product@redwood.com.

4) MAP/close timeline (proposed, editable):
- Day 0: SIG received (we have it) + DPA template received (you said COB Tue)
- Day 3: Redwood returns redline + SOC 2 snapshot attached
- Day 7: BlueCrest returns redline/comments to Redwood
- Day 10: Finalize DPA; begin DocuSign routing
- Day 12: Signatures complete; onboarding sprint kick-off

If those windows work, I’ll push the MAP to DocuSign and create a HubSpot playbook for the onboarding tasks. DocuSign link will be sent once Rohit confirms there aren’t additional redline blocks.

Next ask: Rohit/Emma — please confirm the procurement signature owner (name + email) so I can route DocuSign correctly.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
